lessons.title: Why Unsupervised? 🔍
lessons.description: Understand unsupervised learning, why clustering matters, and where it's used in the real world.

lessons.title: K‑Means Clustering 🎯
lessons.description: The most famous clustering algorithm: centroids, iterations, the elbow method, and its limitations.

lessons.title: Hierarchical Clustering 🌳
lessons.description: Build tree‑like clusters with agglomerative methods, linkage criteria, and dendrogram interpretation.

lessons.title: DBSCAN: Density‑Based Clustering 🌌
lessons.description: Discover clusters of arbitrary shape, detect noise, and choose epsilon and min_samples wisely.

lessons.title: Evaluating Cluster Quality 🧪
lessons.description: Silhouette score, Davies‑Bouldin index, and strategies to pick the right clustering method.
